summary: Shows becoming a Windows account with no password (like Guest) by setting ansible_become_password to an empty string and disabling the LimitBlankPasswordUse policy, while warning against passwordless accounts.
questions: How do I become a Windows account that has no password?
How do I allow blank passwords for become?

answer_card.title: Becoming accounts without a password
answer_card.answer_md:
Avoid passwordless accounts where possible. To become one (e.g. `Guest`), set `ansible_become_password: ''` and disable the "Limit local account use of blank passwords to console logon only" policy:

```yaml
- ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa
    name: LimitBlankPasswordUse
    data: 0
    type: dword
    state: present
```
